ordinaryProcessAttempts.scope: 21 migrated ordinary original cases, 12 strict controls, existing ordinary composition cases
ordinaryProcessAttempts.mechanism: file-local child_process guard installed before imports; teardown always verifies attempts after all cleanup; global runner guard is a later cut

strictResponses.settlement: required captured inputs, source head/configuration reads and one unavailable measurement; branch, candidate, provisional source, gate execution and commands forbidden; caught failures retained
strictResponses.session: literal topology/ownership and source paths; materialization required once for starting sessions; finite hook/check/command responses, exact cwd/environment/deadline/output path, unknown operations and caught assertions retained
strictResponses.shell: schema correction declares one exact command and real marker/output-file effect; no shell interpreter in the double

nativeGapCorrection: PB3-S04 original protected-shell fixture supplied complete only, while completion requested changed too. Its old assertion error was caught as unavailable. The fixture now explicitly supplies changed/not-checked; every original assertion and inner actual execFile callback remain unchanged, while registration fixture arguments add strict command metadata. Its complete registration is not byte-identical.

resources.nativeGroupCleanup: each spawned detached group registered for reverse cleanup; kill then bounded absence assertion, including failures
resources.nativeShellCleanup: real descendant pgrep absence, timeout/cancellation and missing late files retained
